header.userPrompt: Fix https://github.com/VirtusLab/orca/issues/190: NoClassDefFoundError for orca/Flow$package$ on case-insensitive filesystems. runner/src/main/scala/orca/flow.scala and flow/src/main/scala/orca/Flow.scala both hold top-level definitions in package orca, so they compile to orca/flow$package$.class and orca/Flow$package$.class, which differ only in case and collide on case-insensitive filesystems (macOS APFS). Rename runner/src/main/scala/orca/flow.scala to a name whose generated $package class does not case-collide with any other top-level-definition file in package orca across modules (check all modules for other such collisions too). Update any references (docs, AGENTS.md, comments) to the old file name. Reference: Fixes #190.
